card.name: "see" in cross-references to label sections
card.fires_on: The word "see" opening a parenthetical or bracketed cross-reference to another label section, such as Adverse Reactions, Warnings and Precautions, or Clinical Studies.

modes.label: Bracketed section pointer
modes.description: "see" inside square brackets after a finding, pointing to a numbered section.

modes.label: Parenthetical section pointer
modes.description: "see" inside round brackets after a statement, pointing to a named section in capitals.

card.writes: It adds little beyond a pull toward section names that follow; the promoted tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on the word "see" when a label sends the reader to another section.
